test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the homonym in the context of the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

They do not say anything but stalk furiously out of the room.

'Stalk' here means ____________.

options.text: the stem or main axis of a plant
to walk in an angry or proud way
to go through an area in search of prey

solution:
The correct answer is **'to walk in an angry or proud way'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the context of the sentence *"They do not say anything but stalk furiously out of the room,"* the meaning of '**stalk**' is:&am
